To my zai,

Happy, Happy, Happy, Happyy 23rd biiirthday po. 🎂

I know you probably didn't expect to hear from me, but I couldn't let this day pass without saying something. You meant too much to me for me to just stay silent on your birthday.

You are one of the most remarkable people I have ever known. You loved me at my lowest, stayed kind even when things got hard, and brought a kind of brightness into my life that I didn't even know I was missing. Dios mabalos for all of that. Truly.

Please don't skip your meals today, of all days. Eat something good, celebrate yourself, and be kind to yourself the way you were always kind to me. You deserve a day that feels as warm and wonderful as you are. Maugma ka, daba. 🤍

I also know that you've already found someone new, and that you're happy now. And honestly? That's all I ever really wanted for you. I hope he cherishes you the way you deserve to be cherished more than I ever did. I hope he loves you with everything he has, protects your heart, and never makes you feel small. You deserve someone who is completely, unapologetically sure about you. Always.

And how can I be sure na you have someone else na? I stalked you. I scrolled through your followers and I saw a profile of a guy and of course, he was wearing your pink cap. Or at least, I think it was. 50/50. But I know you have a cap with the same design, same color, same everything. So maybe I'm wrong. Maybe I'm not. Either way, I think I already know the answer HAHAHA.

I hope you're okay now not just on the surface, but deeply, genuinely okay. I hope the guilt is gone, the weight is lifted, and that you wake up every morning feeling lighter than the day before. You carried so much for so long, and you deserve to finally just breathe.

I really, really miss you po. I won't pretend otherwise. But I meant every word I said and I'll keep my promises. Don't worry about me. I'll be okay too, in time. Enjoy your day po💗

Padaba ta ka. Always. That's something time won't change. 🤍

Happy 23rd, zai.
— Justin 💗
